latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor API skill.

- Edit and export videos programmatically via simple chat prompts.
- Automates backend session creation and token handling; shows connection status.
- Supports uploading clips, sending text-based edit instructions, and exporting in various video formats.
- Presents export/download links, timeline summaries, and handles errors (file type, quotas, rate limits).
- Handles audio, video, and text tracks; workflows for quick edits, batch jobs, and iterative refinement.
- Optimized for short MP4 clips and fast cloud GPU rendering; max input size 500MB.
